name: Tatry mountain resorts, a.s.
summary: Tatry mountain resorts, a.s., together with its subsidiaries, provides tourism services in Slovakia. It operates through seven segments: Mountains Resorts, Leisure Parks, Golf, Dining, Sports Services and Stores, Hotels, and Real Estate.
